High Court Judges (Leave Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order 2011

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 4 of 2011
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 4 of 2011
HIGH COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION
AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2011.
An Order further to amend the Supreme Court
Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary Part I,
11th October: 20111
No.F.2(2)/2011-Pub.-.-The following President's
Order promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the High Court Judges (Leave-, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.3 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make
the following Order;--
1. Short title and commencement.---(l) This Order may be called the High Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) order, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the
first day of July, 2011.
